name: Futaba☆Channel 4
source:
Summer vacation. 
Long days without plans or worries. 
This summer twin sisters---Hinata and Mizuki---are trusted to mind the house alone. 

But the twins have been transformed by a certain wishing stone...

"What the...... I turned into a girl!?"

The transgender fantasy ADV series continues! 
Boy-turned-girl yuri and lesbian sex.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE125755.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
暑假。
漫长的日子里没有计划，也没有忧虑。
今年夏天，双胞胎姐妹——日向和水希——被委托独自看守房子。

但这对双胞胎却被某种许愿石改变了……

“什么……我变成了女孩！？”

变性奇幻ADV系列继续！
男孩变女孩的尤里和女同性恋。
